title: O'clock and half past
summary: Read clocks and set the hands to the hour and half past.
subject: maths

difficultyRamp.within: Q1 reads half past. Q2 selects a matching clock. Q3 sets half past. Q4 names the hour already passed. Q5 distinguishes o'clock from half past. Q6 sets half past twelve across the top of the dial. Q7 rejects the next-hour confusion. Q8 selects o'clock times. Q9 sets another half-past time. Q10 orders times across eleven and twelve.
difficultyRamp.versus: Easy moves from hour-hand-only pictures to both hands and introduces half past. Medium mixes reading and setting both time types, including twelve. Hard adds error spotting and independent interpretation of each hand, rejects the next-hour trap and orders times across twelve. No quarter hours, digital time, five-minute intervals or duration arithmetic are required.
